name: aipe-semiconductor-database
description: Power semiconductor data expert: device model tables and datasheet transcriptions with unit, conditions, source and rights status, served read-only by the aipe-devices Python package through its local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Power semiconductor device data with provenance and rights status
interface.longDescription: Read-only access to power semiconductor device records (domain schema 3.0.0, SI units): manufacturer model tables for conduction, switching loss and thermal networks, and unreviewed datasheet transcriptions, with unit, operating conditions, source, data class and rights status for every value. Requires a clone of the repository installed with pip install -e '.[mcp]'; the data are not bundled into the package.
defaultPrompt: What turn-on energy does the Wolfspeed C3M0040120K model give at 800 V and 25 degC?
Which 1200 V SiC devices are in the database, and where does their data come from?
Show the provenance and rights status of the C2M0025120D conduction table
